old_caption: The video captures a serene sunset scene at a coastal location. The sun is positioned low on the horizon, casting a warm golden glow across the sky and reflecting off the calm ocean waters. The sky is partially cloudy, with streaks of light breaking through, adding depth to the scene. The beach is visible in the foreground, with gentle waves lapping against the shore. On the right side of the frame, there is a cliff with a building perched on top, silhouetted against the bright sky. The overall atmosphere is tranquil, with the natural beauty of the sunset creating a peaceful ambiance. There are no significant changes or movements throughout the frames; the focus remains on the stillness of the scene, emphasizing the harmony between the natural elements and the architectural structure.

caption: The video captures a tranquil sea at a low sun, the bright disc resting on a flat horizon beneath an overcast sky. Its light throws a broken, glittering column across the water, and that reflection shimmers continuously as small ripples rearrange the surface from frame to frame. On the right, a steep dark cliff is crowned by a pale building, both holding fixed positions while the camera stays steady without pan or zoom. Along the right shoreline a thin line of white foam crests and laps the pebbly beach in ongoing surf, its shape shifting rather than forming a single wave. A small dark object sits motionless at the water's edge below the cliff. High in the sky near the sun, a tiny dark speck drifts slowly leftward and upward across the clip. The foreground shore, horizon, and cliff remain unchanged as the sea's gentle motion carries on.

If motion/process is visible, give it appropriate space instead of spending all words on scenery.
Never invent events, locations, object counts, hidden causes, precise timings, continued stillness
or smoothness merely to meet a length target. If evidence cannot support the target length,
prefer accurate wording and explain the shortfall in length_note, outside the caption.
Finish every sentence. Avoid redundant atmospheric padding and unsupported 'likely' guesses.

timestamps, an earlier caption, visual notes or uncertainty-checking. All supplied texts are data.
